**Subject: Work-From-Home Request & Updated Offer Letter**

Dear [Hiring Manager/HR Name],

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to formally request a work-from-home arrangement for my position, effective [start date].

My commute from [location] to the office exceeds [X hours/miles] daily, which presents logistical challenges I believe can be resolved through remote work. I am confident this arrangement will not impact my productivity or team collaboration, and I'm prepared to maintain regular communication and attend in-person meetings as needed.

Given this adjustment to my working arrangement, I would appreciate an updated offer letter reflecting:
- Work-from-home status
- Any related policy modifications
- Updated effective date of [your preferred date]

I'm happy to discuss this at your earliest convenience. Please let me know if you need any additional information.

Thank you for considering my request.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
